name: getlib-mcp
description: GetLib MCP - powerful modular self-hostable library docs MCP server and dashboard (Context7 alternative)

scripts.build:mcp: bun build src/server/mcp/stdio-entry.ts --outfile dist/mcp.js --target node --format esm --minify --banner '#!/usr/bin/env node' && chmod +x dist/mcp.js
scripts.check:no-em-dash: rg -lP "\x{2014}" --glob '!node_modules/**' --glob '!.next/**' --glob '!.git/**' --glob '!bun.lock' --glob '!AGENTS.md' . && echo 'EM DASH FOUND' && exit 1 || (rg -lP '\\u2014|—|—' src --glob '*.ts' --glob '*.tsx' --glob '*.css' && echo 'EM DASH CIRCUMVENTION FOUND' && exit 1 || echo 'no-em-dash: clean')
scripts.lint: tsc --noEmit && bun run check:no-em-dash && bun run check:boundaries
scripts.validate: bun run typecheck && bun run check:no-em-dash && bun run test && bun run build
scripts.test: GET_LIB_MODE=development GETLIB_AUTHENTICATICATION_ENABLE=false GETLIB_DEFAULT_ACCOUNT= GETLIB_DEFAULT_PASS= GETLIB_SESSION_SECRET= GETLIB_DATABASE_MODE= GETLIB_SUPABASE_URL= GETLIB_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY= GETLIB_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY= GETLIB_SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY= SUPABASE_URL= SUPABASE_ANON_KEY= SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY= SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY= NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY= bun test
